arguments.sql:
WITH sales_window AS (
    SELECT week_date, region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type, sales
    FROM main.cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_date >= '2020-03-23' AND week_date < '2020-09-07'
),
attribute_sales AS (
    SELECT 'region' AS attribute_type, region AS attribute_value, week_date, sales
    FROM sales_window
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'platform', platform, week_date, sales FROM sales_window
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'age_band', age_band, week_date, sales FROM sales_window
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'demographic', demographic, week_date, sales FROM sales_window
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'customer_type', customer_type, week_date, sales FROM sales_window
),
period_totals AS (
    SELECT
        attribute_type,
        attribute_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
    FROM attribute_sales
    GROUP BY attribute_type, attribute_value
),
attribute_averages AS (
    SELECT
        attribute_type,
        AVG(100.0 * (sales_after - sales_before) / NULLIF(sales_before, 0))
            AS avg_percentage_change
    FROM period_totals
    GROUP BY attribute_type
)
SELECT
    attribute_type,
    avg_percentage_change,
    CASE
        WHEN avg_percentage_change < 0
            AND avg_percentage_change = MIN(avg_percentage_change) OVER ()
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_highest_negative_impact
FROM attribute_averages
ORDER BY avg_percentage_change ASC NULLS LAST, attribute_type
LIMIT 5

WITH period_sales AS (
    SELECT region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type, sales,
           week_date < '2020-06-15' AS is_before
    FROM main.cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_date >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days')
      AND week_date < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days')
),
attribute_sales(attribute_type, attribute_value, is_before, sales) AS (
    SELECT 'region', region, is_before, sales FROM period_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'platform', platform, is_before, sales FROM period_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'age_band', age_band, is_before, sales FROM period_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'demographic', demographic, is_before, sales FROM period_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'customer_type', customer_type, is_before, sales FROM period_sales
),
value_totals AS (
    SELECT attribute_type, attribute_value,
           SUM(CASE WHEN is_before THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
           SUM(CASE WHEN is_before THEN 0 ELSE sales END) AS sales_after
    FROM attribute_sales
    GROUP BY attribute_type, attribute_value
)
SELECT attribute_type,
       AVG(100.0 * (sales_after - sales_before) / NULLIF(sales_before, 0))
           AS average_percentage_change
FROM value_totals
GROUP BY attribute_type
ORDER BY average_percentage_change ASC, attribute_type
LIMIT 5
